edits.current: CONDITIONAL PAIR. Simple S.A. asks 'Deseas que las severance savings de todos los employees incluidos en esta return sean enviadas a un solo severance-savings fund?'. Answering YES overwrites the per-employee fund with one value for the whole return. For a real employer the answer is almost always NO, because the fund is the EMPLOYEE'S statutory choice (Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3: 'en el fondo de cesantia que el mismo elija'). Answering YES to save keystrokes deposits other people's money into the wrong fund and does not discharge the obligation. Set to N and let T09 carry the per-employee value.

edits.current: SCOPE: the amount is owned by the Wage Type Catalogue, not the Data Dictionary - the scope rule routes 'Base Salary / Basic Salary amounts -> WTC, NOT DD'. The 'Payroll.' prefix marks it as outside DD master data; it is a standing contract attribute, not a per-run computation. Column E is therefore N and the Data Dictionary holds no Contractual Salary field. Mandatory. Nine integers, no decimals, no commas, no points, not less than zero. The layout is explicit about WHICH salary: 'el ultimo basic salary reportado en el mes de diciembre del ano accrued de severance savings'. THIS IS THE OPERATOR'S REPORTING FIELD, NOT THE STATUTORY BASE. CST art. 253 fixes the statutory base as the last monthly salary provided it has not varied in the last three months, otherwise the average of the last year of service (or of the whole period if shorter), INCLUDING the transport allowance. The field name says 'basico' and the operator's calculator uses it alone - see the trap documented at T14. Report the December basic here and compute T14 yourself. Source: wage type 63807 'Basic Salary Base Amount' in the December period of the accrual year (the full contractual monthly salary). Do NOT use wage type 62100 'Ordinary Salary', which is the amount actually paid in the month, prorated for absences, and is therefore equal to or lower than 63807, never higher. The Master Data field 'Basic Salary' is a snapshot of the month the report is run and is valid for T12 only when taken for December.

edits.current: Mandatory, nine integers. TWO RULES AND ONE TRAP. Rule one, the floor: 'el value minimo del collection debe ser de un (1) dia de un (1) SMLMV del ano accrued' - for accrual year 2026 one day of the SMMLV of COP 1,750,905 is COP 58,363.50, so a record below that is rejected. Rule two, the override: the layout's own formula is basic salary * (dias worked / 360) BUT 'en este campo el contributor puede especificar un value diferente y no se haran calculos automaticos de este value'. THE TRAP: the operator's formula omits the TRANSPORT ALLOWANCE, which CST art. 253 requires in the base. For an employee on the 2026 minimum wage the operator would compute 1,750,905 while the statute requires (1,750,905 + 249,095) = 2,000,000 - a shortfall of COP 249,095 that is a SHORT DEPOSIT, penalised at one day's salary for every day of delay under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's own figure into this field and never rely on the portal calculator. Where the monthly advance regime of MA01 is in use, this field carries the CONSOLIDATED annual figure and only the difference computed at MA05 is actually deposited in February. WHAT IS DEPOSITED - NET OF DIRECT PAYMENTS ALREADY MADE: T14 carries the amount actually deposited for the employee = the consolidated 31 December balance (IN01) LESS the lawful partial payments already made directly to the employee during the accrual year (CST art. 254; Population Rules Step 1 (f)) and LESS any direct payment of that balance made in January to an employee who left before the deposit, which is lawful under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4. An employee who left and was paid in full in the final settlement is not in the return at all (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (2)). Keep the gross annual liquidation as a separate engine value: System Mapping 'Cesantias_Annual_Liquidation' is the gross figure, T14 is the net deposit. Wage-type mapping: the February fund deposit is wage type 25827 / 65805 'Payment Severance Funds Inf.'. The consolidated 31 December balance is the absolute value of wage type 63814 'Severance Balance (Current Month)' in the January period; it is the annual liquidation ('ces base' 68040 x days / 360) less the in-year direct payments 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay' (paired with 62117 'Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay' for the interest). A January direct payment of part of that balance is wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year', and the deposit then carries the remainder: 25827 (February) + 62126 (January) = |63814| (January). The engine does NOT generate a direct payment of the consolidated balance to an employee who remains in service: CST art. 254 prohibits it except for the authorised housing and education purposes, so the only direct payments that reduce T14 for an active employee are those lawful partial payments; any other request to pay the consolidated balance directly to an active employee is rejected, and the balance is deposited in full. A full direct payment with fehaciente evidence is handled through E92. Where the remainder after direct payments falls below the one-day SMMLV floor the channel rejects the record and the residue is settled with the employee (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (5)). The base 68040 exceeds the December basic salary 63807 wherever variable pay is averaged under CST art. 253, which is why T14 must never be left to the operator's basic-salary formula.

edits.current: THE CHANNEL FOR THE MONTHLY ADVANCE IS NOT THIS FILING - IT IS PILA. Law 2466 art. 64 para. 1 instructs MinSalud to regulate the PILA accordingly, and the draft decree makes the point twice: the advance is paid 'exclusivamente a traves de la Integrated Contribution Settlement Return (PILA) -PILA-' (draft art. 4 para. 3) and 'debera reportarse en la PILA como contributions al sistema de severance savings mediante el tipo de contribution que defina el Ministry of Health and Social Protection' (draft art. 1 para. 2). The same paragraph gives MinSalud SIX MONTHS from the decree's entry into force to adjust PILA, and the funds and information operators a FURTHER SIX MONTHS from that regulation to build. While the decree remains a draft and no PILA contribution type exists, the feature cannot be switched on and the annual return remains the only lawful route. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. edits.current: CST art. 57 para. 4, added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, verbatim: 'Cuando el employer acredite de manera fehaciente el payment directo al employee del value correspondiente a las severance savings, dicho payment se considerara liberatorio de la obligacion, y no procedera sancion por no consignacion, salvo que se demuestre que el payment no se realizo en condiciones de libertad y que no fue utilizado en fines autorizados por la Law. No obstante, la afiliacion a Severance-savings fund es mandatory.' Three limits the engine must respect: the discharge needs FEHACIENTE evidence, it is rebuttable on the freedom-and-purpose test, and it does NOT remove the duty to affiliate the employee to a fund. A DRAFTING NOTE on the citation: art. 15's enacting formula announces only 'los paragrafos 2 y 3' of CST art. 57, yet the published text prints a Paragrafo 4 and this is it - so cite CST art. 57 para. 4 as added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, and expect the discrepancy to be raised. Wage-type mapping of direct payments: during the year, wage type 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay'; in January, wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year'; the fund deposit, wage type 25827, then carries the remainder of the balance. This flag covers a FULL discharge of the deposit obligation by proven direct payment (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (4)). An employee who left and was paid directly in the final settlement is NOT an E92 case but a Step 0 exclusion (2) under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4, and a January direct payment to an employee who left before the deposit is treated as that lawful payment. A partial direct payment does not set E92 = Y: T14 carries the deposit net of the direct payments already made and the record is still produced. The engine does not generate a direct payment of the consolidated balance to an employee who remains in service except for the housing and education purposes authorised by CST art. 254; such lawful partial payments reduce T14, and any other direct payment to an active employee is rejected. E92 = Y only for a full discharge with fehaciente evidence (see T14).
